messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — planning to enable rl-model-v2 in the catalog for EU region tomorrow night during the change window (02:00-04:00 UTC).
Kevin Patel: ack. what's the fallback ordering? we should keep the quantized variant first fallback.
Maria Chen: proposed order: rl-model-v2 (enabled) -> rl-model-v2-quant -> rl-model-v1 (legacy). pin rl-model-v1 for 24h if we need instant revert.
Anya Sokolov: can we set automated rollback on error_rate and latency? suggest error_rate > 1.2% OR p99 latency +200ms over baseline -> rollback.
Jonathon Lee: agree. also add token-cost spike detection: +30% cost for 10m.
Release Manager: I'll draft release notes and releasebot entry. Short blurb: "Enable rl-model-v2 in EU, fallback ladder configured, canary at 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Guardrails enabled."
deploy-bot: Deploy started: catalog.enable rl-model-v2 -> target regions: eu-west-1 -> canary 10% at 1745001234
Maria Chen: checklist in thread: 1) pin list prepared 2) metrics dashboards ready 3) rollback playbook in hand
Anya Sokolov: pin config snippet: ```
catalog:
  enable: rl-model-v2
  fallback_order:
    - rl-model-v2-quant
    - rl-model-v1
  pinned_versions:
    rl-model-v1: 24h
  rollback_triggers:
    error_rate_pct: 1.2
    p99_delta_ms: 200
    cost_spike_pct: 30
```
Kevin Patel: :eyes: Can we also set a soft-deprioritize for rl-model-v1 on routing so new traffic prefers quant before legacy?
Jonathon Lee: yes, set routing weight adjustments rather than hard removal. that avoids cache warmup issues.
sre-bot: Alerting configured: catalog/rl-model-v2/error_rate, catalog/rl-model-v2/p99_latency, infra/gpu_utilization. Pager on-call if any trigger crosses threshold.
deploy-bot: Canary update: 10% applied, health checks passing after 5m. metrics link: https://dash.redwood.internal/r/rl-model-v2/canary/10
Maria Chen: starting 10 -> 50% ramp in 30m if no alerts. tagging release notes with rollback steps.
Kevin Patel: if we hit error_rate 0.9-1.2% consider throttle (pause ramp) instead of immediate rollback to gather traces.
Anya Sokolov: noted. add trace collection step: increase sampling for the model to 100% for 15m when error_rate > 0.8%.
Release Manager: I've published release notes draft: "rl-model-v2 enable — canary rollout, fallback ladder, rollback triggers, contact: @Maria Chen" link: https://confluence.redwood/release/rl-model-v2
deploy-bot: Canary at 50% (ramp completed). Health: green. No alerts.
Jonathon Lee: starting QA smoke: run internal eval set, measuring ROUGE/QA deltas. will post pass/fail in 10m.
Maria Chen: reminder: if we roll back, use pinned rl-model-v1 with immediate pinpoint traffic shift (no gradual ramp) to avoid flapping. document in playbook.
Jonathon Lee: smoke pass. minor output variations within expected thresholds.
Kevin Patel: cost spike monitor reported a temporary +12% for the canary, within expected.
sre-bot: Notice: infra/gpu_utilization spiked to 88% for a single pod, but autoscaler compensated.
deploy-bot: Rollout completed to 100% for eu-west-1. Time: 1745004000.
Maria Chen: thanks team. we'll keep enhanced sampling and 24h close watch. schedule a post-mortem if rollback happens.
Release Manager: I'll finalize notes and email enterprise customers in morning window. tagging docs for changelog. :shipit:
Kevin Patel: small follow-up: add fallback ordering test to CI to validate catalog ordering after deploy.
Maria Chen: added to backlog, will PR tomorrow.
deploy-bot: Thread closed by deploy-bot at 1745004567
